The purposes and objectives of the Board are:
1. To serve as an institutional link between the
goverment and private sectors involved in the Fhi-
lippine Virginia tobacco industry;
2. To serve as a planning and programming unit
for the development and promotion of the Philippine
Virginia tobacco industry, particularly in the areas
of research, extension work and marketing
J. To atudy and recourend syetems or standards
of classification and grading of flue-cured tobacco
and proper handling and packaging in order to make
the Philippine Virginia Tobacco acceptable in the
domestic and foreign markets;
110
4. To formulate and recommend consistent to-
bacco research policios and comprehensive scienti-
fic and technological programs for implementation
by the government and private sectors in regions
where its application is feasible or profitable to
Virginia tobacco farmers;
5. To promoto coordination and cooperation in
tobacco reseerch and extension work in order to
minimize duplication of efforts;
6. To encourage and facilitate the active per-
ticipation of Lonestic and foreign sectors in fur-
nishing financial, technological and other forms
of assistance and for the exchange of information
among local and foreign institutions, researchers
and workers;
7. To review and analyze flue-cured tobacco
rescarch projects, schedules of activities, programs
and project proposals, and to recommend auch mea-
sures as may be necossary to accomplish the objec-
tives and policies involved in these activitios;
8. To advise the President of the Philippines
on Philippine Virginia tobacco matters.
To carry out the purposes and objectives men-
tioned hereinabove, the Board shall have the power
and is authorized:
1. To accept and receive from public and pri-
vate sectors specific proposals, scientific and/
or technological research and development programs
or plans and financial, technical and other sup-
port for the purpose of developing and promoting
the Philippine Virginia tobacco industry;
2, To rocommend the award of grants to to-
bacco resenrchers and inventors for their contri-
butions towards the attainment of maximun effi-
ciency ir tobacco production, ouring and other
aspect of research;
111
3. To recomend the grant of scholarships in
tobacco science and technology to deserving govern-
ment employees or citizens, priority being given to
sons and daughters of progressive tobacco growers;
4. To recommend travel grants for scientific
and technological purposes;
5. To recommend the sending of delegates or
observers to tobacco science or trade congresses,
conferences or conventiona;
6. To promote and sponsor scientific and tech-
nological conferences and conventions in the Philip-
pines on matters dealing with the Philippine Vir-
ginis tobacco induntry;
7. To recommend tobacco trade attaches with
proper scientific background;
B. To grant incentive avards to tobacco Gro-
wers for excellence in the production of quality
flue-cured tobacco;
9. To enter, make and execute contracts of any
kind as may be necessary or incidental to the at-
tainment of its purposes with any person or corpo-
10. To make rules and regulations, subject to
the approval of the President of the Fhilippines,
to govern the Board and the disposition and disburse-
ments of its funds; and
Il. To do all such things, transaot all such
business and perform such functions directly or in-
directly necossary, incidental or conducive to the
attainment of the purposes and objectives of the
The Board, in the pursuit of its objectives,
shall coordinate with government as well as private
offices and agencies, which are involved one way or
another in the Philippine Virginia tobacco industry.
112
The books of accounts of the Board shall be
subject to audit by the Auditor General or his re-
presentative in accordance with law.
The Board may call upon any department, bureau;
office, agency or instrumentality pf the soverent,
including government-owned and controlled corpora-
for such assistance as it may need in the
pursuit of its purposes and objectives.
The Board shall ronder annually, or as often
as it nay deem necessary, to the President of the
Philippines roports of its activities and recon-
mendations.
